shop.name: Bike Vault
shop.tagline: Premium road and gravel bikes. Inspected, serviced and ready to ride.
shop.hours: Meetings by appointment. Message us for available times.
shop.address: Safe public meeting spots around Vancouver, BC, agreed when you book.

txt.t_l:
Send photos through the form for an approximate offer.
We meet at a public place by appointment to inspect your bike in person.
We confirm the offer on the spot. Put the value toward any bike here, or take it as payment. No obligation.
We cross check each bike’s serial number against stolen-bike databases before buying.
txt.si_l:
Submit your trade-in. Fill out our trade-in form with photos of your bike and select the shipping option.

Get an initial offer. We'll review your submission and send an estimated trade-in value by email and text.

Pack and ship your bike. Any local bike shop can help pack your bike for shipping. You'll pay the shipping cost upfront. Keep your shipping receipt and take photos of the packed bike before sealing the box.

We inspect your bike. Once it arrives, we'll inspect its condition and confirm your final offer. If the offer differs from our initial estimate, we'll explain why before you decide whether to proceed.

Get your shipping cost reimbursed. Your shipping expense will be added to your trade-in value, whether you choose store credit toward another bike or cash payment.
txt.t_n: We usually reply within 2 hours on business days.
txt.si_n: Estimates are approximate and the final offer is made after inspection. If you decide not to accept the final offer, we are unable to cover return shipping, so the bike would be sent back at your cost.
txt.so_h: Why Don't We Have a Storefront (Yet)?
txt.so_l:
We're focused on keeping bike prices as low as possible. By operating without the overhead of a traditional retail storefront, we can pass those savings on to our customers.

Instead, our inventory is stored across multiple secure locations, helping us keep operating costs and risks low while offering better value to both buyers and sellers.
txt.so_n: No expensive storefront. Less overhead. Better bike prices.
txt.intro: Accurate market pricing, powered by a database updated daily.
txt.ft: Prices in Canadian dollars. Availability can change; please confirm before travelling.
txt.b_l:
Message us or book a viewing for the bike you want.
We agree on a public place and time that suit you.
Look it over, check the fit and test ride it.
Ask our mechanic any questions.
If you are happy, we complete the sale in person.
